note: Part 3 BORDER maxed out (2026-09-24), standalone runner frozen at frame 300, exit screenshot at 14,000,000 cycles on both models (7M is before the freeze). At the freeze the stub paints the border green (BORDER_PASS 5); selfcheck has switched the bar runs to $D021 only, so the sides keep the verdict and the middle keeps the bars. Eight sprites on PAL (five on NTSC, bases 63 + 24k) on X and Y sines, frozen after 300 Y steps and 301 X steps (setup's build advances X once): ring X 230 Y 73, disc X 24 Y 77 (NTSC 86), C X 371 Y 83 (NTSC 101), the 6 X 4 Y 119 (NTSC 146), the 4 X 300 Y 122 (NTSC 158), K X 14 Y 148 (PAL only); B and the thin ring are off-screen right on PAL. Bars: gradient roll 20 at the freeze; the top run (PAL 30 to 42, NTSC 36 to 42) shows entries 20.. from its first line, but PAL's line-30 write lands after the sample column so 31 is the first coloured line there. The two big rows (lines 227 to 242) show halves 37 to 76 of the message: 'E: BORDER   EIGHT SPR'. Boxes were measured on the shots with PIL (colour index by nearest palette entry) and agree with the arithmetic except the C's lines, one higher than computed.
